children: When the late Jack and Jeanette Haley purchased their Seal Beach, Calif., home near Los Angeles for $165,000 in 1974, it initially served one purpose: easy surfing access. A local icon, Jack won the men's division of the 1959 West Coast Surfing Championship, one of the earliest major U.S. surfing competitions.
Each morning, "the first thing he would do is check the waves right out the bedroom window and decide whether to go surfing or not," says their son, Tim Haley.

Over the years, the couple collected antiques they planned to use inside a future dream home. But when time came to move on from Seal Beach and build something new, they realized they had everything they needed, right there on the beach.

In the late '80s, the Haleys expanded the Spanish Mediterranean-inspired house and outfitted it with their treasures. Jack was so proud of the result, he would give tours to strangers off the street, Tim says. "He just had that pride and joy."

The remodel included an unusual amenity: a roulette table that doubles as a kitchen island. The Haleys covered the table with thick glass, making it functional for preparing food or playing the casino game, which the family often did using fake money or silly bets.
"A lot of homes have beautiful granite and marble islands — not a roulette wheel," says Tim, 60.
The Haleys used millwork from an antique Parisian hotel lobby for the library. They also installed inlaid wood floors from Russia.

Jack died in 2000. Tim, who owns a condo nearby, moved into the house part-time in 2020 to spend more time with Jeanette, who died in 2024. Now, the house is too big for him and his sister, who also lives there.
The sunsets. "Every single one is different," Tim says. "You cannot get enough of them."
The vacuuming. "It's a large home to clean."
The property's main draw is its oversize beachfront lot, says Phil Malamatenios of Pacific Sotheby's International Realty. A nearby home sold for $12.5 million in 2025.

Across Seal Beach, single-family homes sold for a median of about $1.76 million from August to October, up 11.8% from the same period a year earlier, according to Redfin. Malamatenios's colleague, Sean Stanfield, has the listing.
